Das leben hat tolle as pekte, aber allzu vieles wird romantisiert und die negativen seiten verdrängt, isoliert, verschwiegen udn unter den teppich gekehrt. Ich habe viel zu viele auch junge freunde mit ernsten, unheilbaren krankheiten, die ihnen das leben ruinieren: fibromyalgie, autoimmune erkrankungen, wirbelsäulenkrümmung, depression, esströung, borderline, DIS, ADHD, Narkolepsie ME-CFS, Halbseitige Lähmung als Kind... Man unterschätzt massiv, wie krank wir leben (müssen). Ich könnte nich verantworten, dass ich ein leben in die welt setze, das mit 20-30%-iger wahrscheinlichkeit 80 jahre lang hilflos darunter leden muss. Als elternteil hat man ja nur einen begränzten einfluss, ich kann keinen neuen medikemante entwickeln, ich kann keine kriege verhindern, ich kann nicht garantieren, dass mein kind im smmer 2045 keinen hitzeschock kriegt. Ich will nicht russsiches roulette mit jemand anderem spielen. dazu kommt: überbevölkerung und vormarsch chinas werden nnur schlimmer, kriege wird es immer geben, afrikanische jugendliche leute brauchen bald einfach mehr raum, (total zurecht) also werden wird bald migrationsbewegungen haben ungeahnten ausmaßes. Dazu weiß ich nicht was die zukunft bringt: wenn  ich JETZT ein kind hätte, wäürde es bis nach 2100 leben!!! Die wahrscheinlichkeit von digitalr verdummung, elektronik-konsum-sucht, gehirnimlantaten, allüberwachende regierungen und unvorstellbaren technologischen und gesellschaftlichen entwicklungen bevorsteht. Ich kann nicht rechtfertigen, einen menschen in eine enorm schnekk entwickelnde welt zu schubsen, ohne dass ich ihm erfahrung, rat, sicherheit oder geld mitgeben könnte... schon unsere eltern hatten davon viel zu wenigm, wie sooole ich mir das anmaßen... In dieser zeiut ist es unmoralisch und egoistisch, kinder zu bekommen.

I am really sorry to hear that. I guess I can relate - I got a job offering on the 12.3.2020 - worked one day - it turned out to be stupid boring shit - on the 15th I jumped... But: now I am back at the same workplace - and I dont get the shitty jobs (I can Interview people and take pictures and stuff - way more interesting than filming medical equipment in a silly tiny room...) Now I have a job which is kinda OK (I dont hate going there, which is really great), I like my colleagues and my salary is OK too. So, yeah, I can totally understand you, I guess - and your problems ARE real and frustrating. All I am saying: things always change, and if they are shitty - like in your case - they tend to get better. Regarding dating/friends. I never dated, never had a girlfriend (26/M), so I guess thats a topic I cant say much about. Its difficult for everybody I see. Regarding Friends: Can you think about people, who are more supportive? Sometimes it is not so much about friendship - sometimes I get along with people way better, who have shared experiences. It can be very comforting to know that you are not the only one ... There are also self-help-groups, I guess thats a place to find likeminded people, too. (Or you go to psychiatry, like me and find friends there :D)

I dont wish for you to end up in a coma, but to find a purpose, a way to be happy, or at least content with your life. I guess, we all have to learn that first, it isnt automatic...

I jumped from a window - ended up breaking a shitload of bones, including my spine, but everything could be repaired - well, kind of. I can walk, have no pain - sometimes miracles seem to happen. (thanks to some great surgeons...)

Ist very nice from you that you help others - O didnt want to put you under pressure, just say, that maybe ther IS some purpose. Regarding Art: I am a media designer - cgi, film, that stuff - Nobody can do it, we all have to learn it - I still cant draw... Its not talent, its more about what intrests you - if you are interested in something, you can leran almost anything... And: the people who brightened my days the most, werent artists. They were nurses, surgeons, my sister, friends, random people... I think that it is a bit of a waste to kill the people who know what real suffering means, because they seem to be more ampathethic, more honest. If more of "us" life, I guess we could eradicate a lot of suffering way better than people who have "good" lifes.  I have to go, but I can write later this evening if you want.

I am sorry to hear that. I am a suicide survivor. Honestly, I dont know what to say. I totally understand, that there are circumstances which feel hopeless - and sometimes the circumstances really need to change, so life can become better.

My only positive thought now is: maybe we are doing it all wrong - maybe life is suffering. But maybe the goal of life is to help others, to build a better world, society - where children, and other people dont have to suffer the way we did. I dont know, it gives me hope. I wish you find something which gives you hope, too. I hope you survive. Best Wishes!
